title: Recover the Ledger
description: The bandits left a chest by the road, and it still has the coin in it. Only the paper is gone. Someone has cut four short scratches into the lid, close together, like a tally that stopped at four - not that there's anyone here to ask why.

objectives.description: Retrieve the trade ledger from the abandoned chest

notes: Soulstone-thread touchpoint 2 of 2 (Tell 1: only the stone was taken - here the coin, not the paper; Tell 3: the four-scratch mark). Neither detail is remarked on by the text; the coin sitting untouched is simply odd bandit behavior on the page, and the scratches are unexplained set dressing.
